package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

const feedbackRunID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011"

func TestSafeValidationSummaryBoundsAndExcludesProviderText(t *testing.T) {
	result := ValidationResult{Outcome: OutcomeFail}
	for index := 0; index < 102; index++ {
		stage := ValidationStage{StageID: "https://private.example/secret", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL"}
		for issue := 0; issue < 102; issue++ {
			stage.Issues = append(stage.Issues, ValidationIssue{Code: "PRIVATE CANARY\nsecret", Message: "PRIVATE_EVALUATION_CANARY <script>solution</script> /private/reference.go"})
		}
		result.Stages = append(result.Stages, stage)
	}
	summary := NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, result)
	if len(summary.Stages) != 100 || len(summary.Stages[0].Issues) != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("summary is not bounded: %d stages, %d issues", len(summary.Stages), len(summary.Stages[0].Issues))
	}
	if summary.Stages[0].StageID != "validation-stage" || summary.Stages[0].Issues[0].Code != "VALIDATION_ISSUE" || summary.Stages[0].Issues[0].Message != SafeSemanticIssueMessage {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe identifiers/messages survived: %+v", summary.Stages[0])
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(summary)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, private := range []string{"CANARY", "script", "/private", "private.example", "reference.go"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), private) {
			t.Fatalf("private provider content leaked: %s", private)
		}
	}
	result.Stages[0].Issues[0].Code = "MUTATED"
	if summary.Stages[0].Issues[0].Code == "MUTATED" {
		t.Fatal("summary aliases provider stages")
	}
}

func TestPublicProjectionDerivesOnlyLatestMatchingSafeSummaryAndStripsPrivateField(t *testing.T) {
	result := ValidationResult{Outcome: OutcomeFail, Stages: []ValidationStage{{StageID: "html.structure", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []ValidationIssue{{Code: "MISSING_ELEMENT", Message: "PRIVATE_CANARY"}}}}}
	run := ValidationRun{ID: feedbackRunID, Status: ValidationRunFailed, Outcome: OutcomeFail, SafeSummary: NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, result)}
	submission := Submission{ValidationRuns: []ValidationRun{run}, ValidationSpecification: json.RawMessage(`{"private":"CANARY"}`)}
	projected := submission.PublicProjection()
	if projected.CurrentValidationSummary == nil {
		t.Fatal("safe current summary unavailable")
	}
	if projected.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary != nil || submission.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary == nil {
		t.Fatal("public projection leaked private run field or mutated original history")
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(projected)
	if strings.Contains(string(encoded), "safe_summary") || strings.Contains(string(encoded), "CANARY") {
		t.Fatalf("private payload leaked: %s", encoded)
	}
	projected.CurrentValidationSummary.Stages[0].Issues[0].Code = "MUTATED"
	if submission.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary.Stages[0].Issues[0].Code == "MUTATED" {
		t.Fatal("public summary aliases stored summary")
	}
	// Even an injected/stale projection field must be replaced from run history.
	submission.CurrentValidationSummary = NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, result)
	submission.ValidationRuns = append(submission.ValidationRuns, ValidationRun{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012", Status: ValidationRunPending})
	if submission.PublicProjection().CurrentValidationSummary != nil {
		t.Fatal("pending retry reused an older summary")
	}
}

func TestCurrentSafeValidationSummaryRejectsLegacyAndCorrelationMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	classification := "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT"
	valid := ValidationRun{ID: feedbackRunID, Status: ValidationRunError, Outcome: OutcomeError, ErrorClassification: classification,
		SafeSummary: NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, ValidationResult{Outcome: OutcomeError, ErrorClassification: classification})}
	cases := map[string]func(*ValidationRun){
		"legacy":                   func(run *ValidationRun) { run.SafeSummary = nil },
		"different run":            func(run *ValidationRun) { run.SafeSummary.ValidationRunID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099" },
		"different outcome":        func(run *ValidationRun) { run.SafeSummary.Outcome = OutcomeFail },
		"different classification": func(run *ValidationRun) { value := "SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT"; run.SafeSummary.ErrorClassification = &value },
		"unknown classification": func(run *ValidationRun) {
			run.ErrorClassification = "PRIVATE_CANARY"
			run.SafeSummary.ErrorClassification = &run.ErrorClassification
		},
		"nonterminal":           func(run *ValidationRun) { run.Status = ValidationRunRunning },
		"wrong status outcome":  func(run *ValidationRun) { run.Status = ValidationRunFailed },
		"absent classification": func(run *ValidationRun) { run.SafeSummary.ErrorClassification = nil },
	}
	for name, mutate := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			run := valid
			copied := *valid.SafeSummary
			run.SafeSummary = &copied
			mutate(&run)
			if (Submission{ValidationRuns: []ValidationRun{run}}).CurrentSafeValidationSummary() != nil {
				t.Fatal("mismatched current summary accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	if (Submission{ValidationRuns: []ValidationRun{valid}}).CurrentSafeValidationSummary() == nil {
		t.Fatal("valid technical ERROR detail unavailable")
	}
}

func TestSafeSummaryEmptyIssuesRemainCompatibleAndClassificationsAreBounded(t *testing.T) {
	result := ValidationResult{Outcome: OutcomePass, Stages: []ValidationStage{{StageID: "html", Outcome: "PASS"}}}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, result))
	if !strings.Contains(string(encoded), `"issues":[]`) || !strings.Contains(string(encoded), `"error_classification":null`) {
		t.Fatalf("safe DTO omitted required nullable/array fields: %s", encoded)
	}
	summary := NewSafeValidationSummary(feedbackRunID, ValidationResult{Outcome: OutcomeError, ErrorClassification: "PRIVATE_CANARY"})
	if *summary.ErrorClassification != "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL" {
		t.Fatal("unknown technical classification was exposed")
	}
}
